summary: Germany (DE) localization of Business Central 29. It covers ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications, VAT-VIES/EU Sales List reporting, GoBD/GDPdU digital audit exports, delivery reminders, Intrastat, physical inventory orders, and XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol e-invoicing. It answers what is German-specific and where it is documented.
overview:
The German layer centres on tax reporting. Sales VAT advance notifications go to ELSTER through own tables and pages (Sales VAT Advance Notif., Elec. VAT Decl. Setup) and codeunits "Elster Management" and "Elster - Initialize". VAT-VIES declarations and the EU Sales List reuse the W1 VAT Report objects (tables 740, 741, 743, codeunits 740, 743, 744), extended with fields, correction lines and an ELMA XML export. Learn documents this in the VAT reporting, Correct VAT Reports and EU Sales List pages.

Further own features are digital audit export (Data Export tables, pages and the Export Business Data report), delivery reminders for vendors (header, line, issued and ledger objects, terms, levels, text), Intrastat Report extensions with IDEV and eSTATISTIK.CORE submission channels, and physical inventory orders and recordings. E-invoicing is built on the E-Document framework with XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol BIS 3.0 DE format codeunits and enum extensions.

Smaller changes touch W1 objects: BilMoG valuation fields for exchange rate adjustment, registration numbers on vendor and purchase documents, tax office fields on Company Information, DACH report selections, and the Correction handling in Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch.
key_points: ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications: own card and list pages, electronic VAT declaration setup, and a report that creates the XML file.
VAT-VIES declaration and EU Sales List: VAT Report tables extended with trade type, correction and supply count fields, plus VIES ELMA XML export for the ELMA5 interface.
GoBD/GDPdU digital audit: Data Exports setup pages, record definitions and sources, and the Export Business Data report that writes a ZIP with XML index.
Delivery reminders for vendors: own header, line, issued and ledger tables, terms, levels and text, create, issue and test reports, and vendor codes.
Intrastat Report DE: extensions for line, header and setup, places of dispatcher and receiver, and IDEV or eSTATISTIK.CORE submission channels.
E-invoicing: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats for import and export, buyer reference handling, and E-Document page extensions.
BilMoG valuation method in exchange rate adjustment (Valuation Method, Valuation Period End Date, Due Date To parameters).
Correction field in general journals for posting negative entries, and registration numbers on vendors and purchase documents.

areas.what: Holds the VAT reporting core. W1 VAT Report tables, codeunits and reports are extended for VAT-VIES and EU Sales List (new header, line and setup fields, correction lines, ELMA XML export). Also adds the Data Export objects for digital audits, German VAT statement and VIES reports, and BilMoG exchange rate adjustment logic.
areas.why: Learn describes VAT-VIES declarations to the BZSt, the ELMA5 interface and GoBD/GDPdU exports for tax audits.

areas.what: Adds the delivery reminder feature: header, line, issued and ledger tables, terms, levels, text, pages, create and issue codeunits and reports. Adds registration number and archiving fields on purchase tables and vendor payment and balance reports.
areas.why: Learn documents setting up, generating, issuing and testing delivery reminders, and the Vendor Payments List report.

areas.what: Implements German e-invoicing through the E-Document framework: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE handlers, import and export codeunits, buyer reference enum, and page and report extensions on sales and service documents.
areas.why: Learn explains the supported formats and buyer reference resolution for e-invoices.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat Report extensions for Germany (setup, header, line, filters, submission channel enum, places of dispatcher and receiver) and a physical inventory order feature with recordings and posted tables. Adds inventory valuation fields on Item Statistics Buffer.
areas.why: Learn describes XML Intrastat export through IDEV or eSTATISTIK.CORE channels.

areas.what: Contains the ELSTER objects: Sales VAT Advance Notif. and Elec. VAT Decl. Setup tables, cards, lists, management codeunits, the XML creation report, role center extensions and ELSTER permission set extensions. Also holds Data Export Setup and upgrade plumbing.
areas.why: Learn describes reporting sales VAT through the ELSTER portal with XML files.

areas.what: Extends Company Information with tax office, area and authorized number fields. Adds DACH report selections, delivery reminder source code and report usage enums, and Format Address, Document-Print and Navigate changes.
areas.why: Learn says tax office and company data on Company Information feed VAT reports.

areas.what: Adds PEPPOL 3.0 DE codeunits for sales and service validation, document info, party info, context and subscribers, plus a format enum extension.
Adds fields on Fixed Asset (BWR depreciation book code, premium depreciation) and changes to depreciation book tables and FA General Report. Adds book value and list reports.
Adds delivery reminder permission set extensions to LOCAL and LOCAL READ and changes those W1 permission sets.
Changes the Export Contact and Export Segment Contact XML ports.
Adds the Customer Total-Balance report and changes the Sales Line Archive table.
Adds an Expense Event Subscriber DE codeunit.
Extends the Manufacturing Manager role center for DACH.
Adds helper procedures for document number label and caption to the Service - Credit Memo report.

issues: Key point 4 says delivery reminders have their own 'ledger tables'. The visible input shows only the page 'Deliv. Reminder Ledger Entries' (the Purchases list is cut off at the issued header table). 'Ledger entries' would be safer wording.
Key point 2 ties the VIES ELMA XML export to the ELMA5 interface. The interface comes from the Learn EU Sales List page, not from the code. This is a reasonable inference.
